What DigitalOcean says to expect

  • Full year 2026: outlookFor the full year 2026, we now expect: • Total revenue of $1.208 to $1.211 billion, up approximately 34% year-over-year. • Adjusted EBITDA margin of 41% to 42%. • Adjusted free cash flow margin in the range of 20% to 22% of revenue. • Non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $1.60 to $1.62
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
